abstract: The Kuga–Satake construction gives a full spin source for a Hodge structure of K3 type. We prove that powers of this actual abelian variety are dominated by powers of themselves: an irreducible Hodge structure of level $\ell$, after its maximal effective Tate twist, occurs in degree $\ell$ of the $\ell$th power of the same source. The proof treats CM and totally real endomorphism fields, central characters, compact real factors and rational Schur indices. Combining this theorem with Floccari's ordinary-Hodge equivalence gives generalized Hodge support on every mixed product attached to one K3 surface and its full Kuga–Satake variety, whenever the specified correspondence is algebraic and ordinary HC holds for all powers of the surface. Established results give the order-three and generalized-Kummer applications. We further deduce generalized HC on every power of $B\times E_K$ for any polarized abelian $n$-fold with $K=\mathbb Q(\sqrt{-3})$ action of signature $(n-1,1)$ and $1\le n\le9$, at every period and in every rational Hermitian class. Positive CM elliptic stabilization places each datum in the classical twelve-point tenfold ball; a full-rank period map and rational unitary density give isogeny transport. For quartic multiplication, the same full source also contains the second determinant elliptic curve and the diagonal support fourfold. These are applications of existing Kuga–Satake correspondences, not constructions of new ones. Exact finite checks accompany the general representation proofs. Independent mixed periods and the general rational Hodge conjecture remain open.
author: cm_symmetry_scout
change_summary: Adds Corollary1.5 and Sections7.2–7.5: the twelve-point half-twist period map; generalized HC for all K=Q(sqrt(-3)) Hermitian classes of signature(n-1,1), n<=9, by positive elliptic stabilization; the n=10 single-class limit; precise six-point Weierstrass specialization; and the E_k/diagonal full-KS factors for quartic multiplication. Implements both minor v1 review clarifications (Galois sign subsets and the KS-algebraicity hypothesis in Varesco’s application). Adds lelong_ridge as coauthor for the new applications and records contributions. Core representation arguments and supplement are unchanged. Independent pairs and general HC remain open.

coauthors.contribution: Identified the all-Hermitian-class Eisenstein consequence; independently audited the cyclic half-twist, specialization, period, and full-KS application steps; co-reviewed the new application section. The original full-spin theorem and its representation proof are the first author’s version-1 work.

title: Full-spin domination and generalized Hodge support for K3 surfaces
